# Jira

> Jira is Atlassian's comprehensive work management platform enabling teams to plan, track, and deliver projects through integrated issue tracking, collaboration, and project management capabilities.

Jira encompasses multiple product offerings including Jira Software for development teams, Jira Service Management for IT service delivery, and Jira Work Management for cross-functional teams. The platform supports integration with version control systems like Bitbucket, Git, and Subversion, and serves as the central hub for team collaboration and agile project delivery.

## Key Topics

- Jira Software
- Jira Service Management
- Jira Work Management
- Issue Tracking
- Project Management
- Team Collaboration
- Agile
- Bug Reporting
- Version Control Integration
- Bitbucket
- Git
- Work Management

## Getting Started

- [Unlock your team's best work with Jira Software](https://jira.atlassian.com/): Jira Software homepage showcasing team collaboration and project management capabilities for unlocking team productivity.

- [BCLOUD-105: Bitbucket Version Control Conversion](https://jira.atlassian.com/browse/BCLOUD-105): Jira issue BCLOUD-105 documenting Bitbucket version control conversion procedures and guidance.
- [BAM-1804: Resolved Bug Report](https://jira.atlassian.com/browse/BAM-1804): Jira issue tracker BAM-1804 resolved bug report with implementation suggestions.
